scripts.deploy:testnet: git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet && GIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD) docker --context syncvotes-testnet compose --project-directory deploy --env-file deploy/testnet.env build && docker --context syncvotes-testnet compose --project-directory deploy --env-file deploy/testnet.env up -d
scripts.deploy:mainnet: git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet && GIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD) docker --context syncvotes-mainnet compose --project-directory deploy --env-file deploy/mainnet.env build && docker --context syncvotes-mainnet compose --project-directory deploy --env-file deploy/mainnet.env up -d
scripts.daml:codegen: pnpm daml:build && rm -rf daml.js && dpm codegen-js daml/.daml/dist/*.dar -o daml.js
